entities.summary: "You Don't Know My Name" is a song recorded by American singer-songwriter Alicia Keys for her second studio album The Diary of Alicia Keys (2003). Written by Keys, Kanye West and Harold Lilly, its production, handled by the former two, is based on a sample of the 1975 song "Let Me Prove My Love to You", written by J. R. Bailey, Mel Kent and Ken Williams, and performed by the Main Ingredient. "You Don't Know My Name" was released as the lead single from The Diary of Alicia Keys on November 10, 2003, by J Records.
